text:
jamie: Heads-up — saw a spike of duplicate SLO alerts in the console for svc-payments. Looks like telemetry normalized the signals differently than the notify layer expects. stack: metrics->ingest->normalize->notify
ash: hmm, can you paste an example?
jamie: log excerpt: `ingest_id=abcd1234 signal_type=latency threshold=95pct route=payments:latency notify_keys=[team-payments,eng-oncall]` then downstream we get `signal_key=svc-payments.latency` and notify fanout treats it as separate event.
priya: that mismatch will cause fanout duplication and blow per-tenant notify quotas. we saw similar with error_budget signals last month.
kevin: is this a normalization key problem or a missing canonical id in the notify payload?
jamie: seems both. ingest uses `ingest_id` and `source_signature`, normalize emits `signal_key` but we never include `canonical_signal_id` in notify payload. notify dedupe only looks at `signal_key`.
ash: quick fix idea: add `canonical_signal_id` (sha256 of <tenant,rule,metric,window>) to normalize output and pass through to notify. dedupe can be switched to that in parallel. low risk.
priya: agree. also we should add a short TTL-based caching at notify fanout: if same canonical id seen within 30s, coalesce. that protects quota.
kevin: two concerns: 1) canonicalization contract means we need stable canonical inputs (labels/renames from console). 2) rollouts: we need canary for tenants so we don't break existing oncall mappings.
jamie: proposal: API change in normalize service to include `canonical_id` (v1). feature flag in notify to enable dedupe by `canonical_id`. rollout plan: 1% tenants -> 10% -> 50% -> all, plus metric for false-suppression.
alert-bot: deploy triggered: normalize-service PR #514 queued, notify-service PR #220 queued (tests green).
priya: also need console UX tweak: show `canonical id` in SLO detail debug pane and a small banner when two alerts were coalesced. support will want visibility.
ash: good call. add telemetry: counter: alerts_coalesced_by_canonical_id, and histogram: coalesce_latency. Also expose sample traces to SRE.
kevin: ownership: normalize infra + notify infra + console. I'll own the migrate plan and run the rollout with smoke tests. can someone add the canary checklist?
jamie: I'll add checklist to the PR and create a tiny smoke script: `scripts/slo_coalesce_smoke.sh` that hits a test tenant with controlled events.
priya: and update quota docs: explain how dedupe reduces per-tenant notify count but still counts unique downstream routed recipients.
ash: one more edge-case: quiet windows. If a tenant has quiet window suppression, coalescing shouldn't resurrect suppressed alerts. make sure notify consults quiet window policy before emitting coalesced alert.
kevin: noted. I'll add that gate in notify.
jamie: action items: jamie -> smoke script + example logs; kevin -> rollout plan + canary checklist; priya -> docs + console banner copy; ash -> add telemetry counters and retention; we'll sync tomorrow after PRs land.
ash: thumbs up :+1:
jamie: thanks — flagging this for the oncall to monitor the next 24h after canary.
alert-bot: reminder: runbook link added https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-coalesce-checklist
